messages:
sam_sales: Hey team, VertexAI POC is flaking with 403s on /v1/generate and a few 429s during a demo ramp. Can we triage quickly?

sam_sales: They pasted this curl (key redacted): ```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer vx_poc_4fXXXX' -H 'X-Redwood-Org: vertex' -H 'X-Redwood-Project: demo' -d '{\"model\":\"redwood-small\",\"input\":\"hi\"}'```

sam_sales: Error messages are `{"error":"permission_denied","message":"org/project binding mismatch"}` and intermittent `{"error":"rate_limited","retry_after":3}` during the ramp.

chris_se: Quick checks: did they create the key in prod vs staging? Slugs often differ (vertex vs vertex-prod). Also confirm if they rotated keys across envs and whether CI/runner cached an old secret.

chris_se: Can you paste the exact header values and the SDK env config (redact secrets)?

sam_sales: They said SDK config used env VARS: REDWOOD_ORG=vertex-prod, REDWOOD_PROJECT=demo-prod but the app logs show headers `vertex`/`demo` for some requests. They think two runners are hitting different env sets.

kai_sre: I'll pull auth events for prefix vx_poc_4f from 2256787200..2256789000. @ops-bot run auth query.

ops-bot: Querying auth index for key prefix "vx_poc_4f" between 2256787200 and 2256789000. Found 14 events: 9 permission_denied (org/project mismatch), 5 rate_limited. Returning redacted samples.

ops-bot: Sample redacted line: `AUTH FAIL key=vx_poc_4f... reason=bound_to=vertex-prod:demo-prod header_org=vertex header_project=demo request=/v1/generate`

kai_sre: Control-plane shows key bound_org=vertex-prod bound_project=demo-prod key_type=service scopes=[generate] — so requests using `vertex`/`demo` will 403. The mixed headers explain intermittent 403s.

chris_se: Root cause: partial env rotation. One set of runners still had old env that wrote `vertex`/`demo` headers. We should ask them to centralize envs and rotate with overlap.

sam_sales: They confirmed two CI pools; one pool missed the deploy with updated env vars. They've updated that pool now and retried — normal calls return 200. The ramp still produced a few 429s at the peak.

kai_sre: 429s during load look like sandbox per-key TPS. We can give a short burst bump for the demo. Approve +50 TPS for 30m?

chris_se: Approve for demo window. Also recommend they use a service key bound to the demo-prod project (they already do) and schedule a one-minute dual-key overlap on future rotations to avoid gaps.

kai_sre: Applying patch: sandbox_quota.bump key=vx_poc_4fXXXX delta=+50 duration=1800s. Revert scheduled at 2256790892.

ops-bot: Patch applied. Monitoring auth events.

sam_sales: Vertex reran the ramp — 200s across the board, no more 403s. Demo passed. They asked about longer-term pricing for sustained TPS; I looped AE in.

elaine_security: Two quick asks: 1) please don't post full keys (we redacted theirs), 2) add a one-line to presales checklist about env consistency across CI pools and a recommended rotation overlap window. Also add a line on org/project exact-match.

chris_se: Will add a short FAQ and open DOCS-9987 to change the 403 text to be more actionable (suggest expected org/project when safe) and to include a troubleshooting checklist for mixed envs.

sam_sales: Thanks all — closing swarm. :tada:
